Name: Summer Squash to Yellow Crookneck
Author: TistoYema
Description:
Summer Squash is now called Yellow Crookneck. Seeds are renamed as well and descriptions remain the same.

I made this mod because I plan to play with Stardew Valley Expanded, which adds a new crop called Butternut Squash that grows during Summer just like, well, the Summer Squash... That bothered me. It was initially just for my own use, but I decided to share it in case anyone else feels the same way.

I don't think this crop is mentioned anywhere else in the vanilla game, let me know if you find something.
